prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1044; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were involved in at an intersection in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather use placeholder details for this one, but I'm the driver of the vehicle that was involved.

Q: Understood. Can you walk me through what happened?

A: I was driving through the intersection and needed to turn left. I was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic, and when it looked clear I started my turn.

Q: Did you have a green light or a left-turn arrow?

A: I had a green light, but there was no separate arrow. I was yielding to oncoming traffic like I normally do.

Q: What happened next?

A: A vehicle coming toward me hit the front passenger side of my car. I felt a hard jolt and my head snapped forward and back.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not clearly. I noticed headlights, but I didn't judge its speed well.

Q: Did you call for medical attention or see a doctor afterward?

A: The paramedics checked me at the scene. Later I went to urgent care because my neck was stiff and my lower back was sore.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: Still sore. My neck hurts when I turn my head, and my lower back aches after sitting for long periods. I've been doing some physical therapy exercises.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?

A: I've missed a few shifts and I'm limited in how much I can lift right now.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm willing to provide any records you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
